annotations.title: Get a task with its context

description: Everything one task needs, in one call: what it asks and what done looks like, who handed it out and who validates it, its state and what it waits on from the user, the reports and messages in its thread, the rikma's code (connected repositories, GitHub/Drive links), the user's own missions there (hours count only on one of them), and the tasks finished there lately with their last report. Read it before working on a task, and show it to the user before acting. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getTaskContextTool
name: getTaskContextTool
